messages:
anya: Quick postmortem from the staging run: when we mass-evicted ~25 medium tenants the continuous-batcher stalled, then target nodes experienced a short NIC spike. Want to capture a minimal set of mitigations.

kevin: Short summary of root causes? was it admission head-of-line or prefetch storm?

anya: Both. Head-of-line due to one evicted request blocking a micro-window; prefetch storm because naive plan kicked off prefetch for all moves at once.

maria: Two small, orthogonal fixes that might buy a lot: 1) adaptive prefetch throttler (rate + concurrency caps that react to node nic/mem signals), 2) lane granularity tune — make lanes coarser during high churn so fewer lanes are quiesced.

lina: For the throttler would we expose a node-level token-bucket and cluster-level backpressure? We should avoid centralized blocks.

kevin: Yes: node-level token-bucket + async feedback events (prefetch.accepted, prefetch.rejected, nic.high). Scheduler respects rejections and retries with exponential backoff. Keep policy local so Private installs can tweak.

maria: Lane granularity: current default N=8. Proposal: dynamic N that halves when eviction_rate > threshold (e.g., 10 evicts/min) to reduce amount of quiescing. Add a debounce so we don't oscillate.

anya: Also propose a cheap fast-path: if a batch head is blocked by an evicted request, allow the batch to proceed by skipping that request and enqueueing a short-circuit token for the client to re-request. That avoids full synthetic placeholders.

lina: Short-circuit seems safe and low-effort. We must ensure tracing marks skipped items so replay is easy.

kevin: Telemetry hooks: emit `prefetch.rate_limit_state`, `lane.count_dynamic`, `batch.head_skips`. Dashboards: overlay `batch.head_skips` vs P99 by tenant.

maria: Rollout: feature-flag throttler on for Dedicated in canary; lane-dynamic off by default for Hosted.

anya: Actionables: I'll draft RFC with API sketch for node throttler + plan hint 'preferred_lane_count'. @kevin add head-skip fast-path prototype. @lina add telemetry events to infra. Sync Thurs 10am PT.

kevin: Ack.

maria: +1

lina: On it.
